title: Striped Placemat
description: A stylish table placemat using double crochet rows with crisp colour changes.
expectationText: A rhythmic row project that builds your confidence with colour changes and creates a beautiful set for your dining table. Make multiples for a matching set.

steps.title: Start with colour A
steps.instruction: Chain 42 with colour A. This gives a placemat about 30 cm wide.

steps.title: Rows 1 to 4 (colour A)
steps.instruction: Double crochet into the third chain from hook and each chain across. Chain 2 and turn.

steps.title: Switch to colour B
steps.instruction: On the last yarn-over of the final stitch in row 4, drop colour A and pull through colour B to create a clean colour change.

steps.title: Rows 5 to 8 (colour B)
steps.instruction: Double crochet across with colour B. Chain 2 and turn.

steps.title: Repeat colour stripes
steps.instruction: Alternate 4 rows of colour A and 4 rows of colour B until the placemat reaches about 45 cm long, roughly 32 rows total.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: After the final row, fasten off and weave in all ends. Block lightly with steam for a flat finish.
